content:
Adds or updates resource links for multiple customer accounts.
Requires the Basic [16] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
required
string <uuid>
The UUID of the parent container for the child containers you want to
bulk add resource links for.
Array of strings
An array of child containers that you want to bulk add resource links
for.
parent_container_uuid
container_uuid_list
required
Array of objects
An array of resource links to bulk add to the child containers.
